title: Order Pipeline
prompt: Given the Order model in scope, implement `Order next_status(Order o)` advancing PENDING -> SHIPPED -> DELIVERED (DELIVERED stays), `int count_status(const Order *os, int n, Order s)` counting matches, and `int shipped_revenue(const Order *os, int n)` summing total_cents of SHIPPED orders.

tests.name: count
tests.code:
OrderRec os[] = {{1, PENDING, 100}, {2, SHIPPED, 200}, {3, PENDING, 300}};
CHECK_EQ(count_status(os, 3, PENDING), 2);

tests.name: revenue
tests.code:
OrderRec os[] = {{1, SHIPPED, 100}, {2, DELIVERED, 400}, {3, SHIPPED, 50}};
CHECK_EQ(shipped_revenue(os, 3), 150);
